text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 391 May 2, 1972
APPOINTING A MEMBER OF THE MINORITY PARTY AS MEMBER IN COMMITTEES ON
PRE-QUALIFICATIONS AND AWARDS IN EACH NATIONAL AGENCY UNDERTAKING
INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS
In the interest of public service a Bi-Partisan Study and Evaluation of all proposed Awards of Contracts for
Infrastructure Projects of the administration is imperative. For this purpose a representative of the minority
party should be made a member in all Committees on Pre-qualifications and Awards for Infrastructure
Projects in the different Bureaus and Offices of the Department of Public Works and Communications and
other national agencies undertaking Infrastructure Projects.
In view of the foregoing, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Republic of the Philippines, by
virtue of the powers vested in me by law hereby appoint one member of the minority party, who possesses the
necessary technical qualifications, to be recommended by the President of the said Party, as member of
standing Committees on Pre-qualifications and Awards in each of the different Bureaus and Offices under the
Department of Public Works and Communications and in other national agencies undertaking Infrastructure
Projects, with the same powers as regular members.
In this connection, the representative of the minority party, who are appointed as members of the
above-mentioned Committees Pre-qualifications and Awards, shall be entitled to per diem of One Hundred
Pesos (P100.00) per meeting, to be borne by the Agency concerned subject to auditing and accounting
regulations.
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-two.
